title: Compatible restrictions of explicit split sums
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and write $B_fT=T\times_XY$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $W,T_1,T_2,Z$ be objects of the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with arrows $h_i:T_i\to W$ and $g_i:Z\to T_i$ satisfying $h_1g_1=h_2g_2$. Let $D_i$ be explicit finite clopen splittings of $B_fT_i$, with sheet sections $\sigma_{i,j}$, as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-splitting-data]. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on that site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and $s\in F(B_fW)$, one has $F(g_1)(\sum_j F(\sigma_{1,j})(F(B_fh_1)(s)))=F(g_2)(\sum_j F(\sigma_{2,j})(F(B_fh_2)(s)))$. No finiteness of $f$ is assumed beyond the supplied finite splittings.

source.place: Section 03SH (section-trace-method), paragraph after Definition 03SE; descent details as in SGA 4, Expose IX, 5.1.

proof.text: Obtain a covering presieve and local bijections of sheets from the local reindexing theorem. Pass from the abelian sheaf to its underlying type-valued sheaf and apply separatedness on that presieve.

On a covering arrow k, expand the sums and move both restrictions through the finite sum by additivity. Use Fintype.sum_equiv with the local bijection. Each corresponding summand is equal by functoriality, since the composite sheet arrows coincide. Thus separatedness yields equality of the two sums.

lean.statement: theorem finiteEtaleTrace_split_sum_compatibility {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : Etale f) : let B := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f ⋙ MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hf ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (W T₁ T₂ Z : X.Etale) (h₁ : T₁ ⟶ W) (h₂ : T₂ ⟶ W) (g₁ : Z ⟶ T₁) (g₂ : Z ⟶ T₂), g₁ ≫ h₁ = g₂ ≫ h₂ → ∀ (D₁ : FiniteEtaleTraceSplitting f T₁) (D₂ : FiniteEtaleTraceSplitting f T₂) (s : F.obj.obj (op (B.obj W))), F.obj.map g₁.op (D₁.sum hf F (F.obj.map (B.map h₁).op s)) = F.obj.map g₂.op (D₂.sum hf F (F.obj.map (B.map h₂).op s))
